title: I want to bring more games to iOS
author: Shortykane
selftext:
I keep asking myself when I see Switch 2 games release... why aren't these just on iOS?? iOS chips are INSANE for being in a mobile device. No.. we can't hit the power or cooling that a Switch gets on an iOS device but we get A LOT to mess with. So I decided to make it my mission to bring better games with more of a Steam feel to iOS.

Lately I have been working on NightPorch my Zombie survival life sim and trying to give more than just a standard gameplay.

I worked with Claude, Gemini, and Codex to create 3 game modes and a custom option that will let you make the perfect game for you.

I'm hoping to see more of us bringing these to iOS to put the heat on the big names in the industry to really improve their games and the availability/price. 

So far.. my game is .99$ lol... much better than $35-70 xD

My brain literally just works in ai-claudish at this point so mind my horrible writing... it's why I usually just have the ai write it hahaha

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Shortykane please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with bare game links. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: je386
comments.body:
I develop my games with kotlin multiplatform and iOS support is built in. I still do not release for iOS, because I would need a mac to test the games properly, also releasing on game store costs $99 per year.

Android costs $25 once, snap store costs nothing, steam costs $99 once per game.
